06-offcatalog-mockup.html.comment: Add an Athletic resources tab to design 6 (06-offcatalog-mockup.html, "Booking up front, split screen" for BNDH Consulting). It gets a link in the main navigation, next to "Athlete mentoring", and opens a new section with four sub-tabs: Books, Articles, Success stories and Educational videos. Visitors switch between the sub-tabs to browse each kind of resource, and Books is open by default. The section uses design 6's existing look: midnight/tint panels, the yellow "ball" accent, pill shapes and line icons.
